dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Phew... Lantern Rite is such a tiring time. I should take a moment to rest...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: But the moment I stop, the anxiety just hits me all over again...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: After all, Lady Yuheng has assigned a new task for the music festival, so I still can't rest...
